objectives.text: Find the card with one black heart that a short green house that is 2 tiles from a tall red house is next to.
Find the card with two green stars that a short red house that is 2 tiles from a tree is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one orange square that a short green house that is beside a short red house is beside.
Find the card with one red plus that a short red house that is 3 tiles from a short green house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one green circle that a short yellow house that is 3 tiles from a short green house is beside.
Find the card with two blue squares that a rock that is next to another rock is next to.
Find the card with one blue square that a rock that is beside a short green house is next to.
Find the card with one green plus that a short green house that is next to a rock is beside.
Find the card with one black star that a short red house that is next to a short green house is next to.
Find the card with one black plus that a short yellow house that is 3 tiles from a short green house is beside.
Find the card with two green hearts that a tall blue house that is beside a short blue house is next to.
Find the card with two orange squares that a tree that is 2 tiles from a short red house is next to.
Find the card with two red squares that a tree that is beside a short red house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two red stars that a tree that is 2 tiles from another tree is 4 tiles from.
Find the card with one orange star that a short green house that is 2 tiles from a tall red house is beside.
